618-1916-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

907-2645-3430-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
907-2645-3430-5475.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

5531-5694-6763-6991-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5531-5694-6763-6991-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
5531-5694-6763-6991-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Donnie & April and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

650-6553-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

372-1987-2781.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1987-2781.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2308-3000-7492.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power or toughness 1 or less.
2034-2308-3000-7492.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature with power or toughness 1 or less, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Arnyn triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Beast creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
Repeat.

2267-4798-5686-7435.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2267-4798-5686-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

4367-7346.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Irma.
4367-7346.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Irma triggers, causing it to become a copy of Akki Battle Squad and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Declare Irma as an attacker. Irma triggers, untapping all modified creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-7193.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Omni-Changeling.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Omni-Changeling and another permanent you control.
Activate Omni-Changeling by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

997-5170-6132-6794.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2034-2919-3490-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-4268.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-3518-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1170-1329-3518-4068.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

585-4321-4508-5880.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Food and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

738-2518-4659-6134.description:
Cast Perilous Myr by paying {2}.
Rendmaw triggers, causing each player to create a tapped 2/2 Bird creature token with flying and that is goaded for the rest of the game.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Perilous Myr, adding {C}{C}.
When Perilous Myr dies, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to a Bird token an opponent controls, thus killing the Bird.
Glissa triggers, returning Perilous Myr from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-678-4826-6644.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ancient Adamantoise enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

510-997-2281.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-3668--39.notablePrerequisites: Flesh Duplicate is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-3668--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Flesh Duplicate trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

864-877-2281-5147.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Repeat.

2034-3635-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Whirler Rogue.
When Whirler Rogue enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2440-4052-4963.notablePrerequisites:
"Bear" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
You have a way to draw a card or put a Bear onto the battlefield or declare a Bear as an attacker.
2440-4052-4963.description:
Activate Words of Wilding.
The next time you would draw a card, create a 2/2 bear token.
Mana Echoes and Kindred Discovery trigger.
Allow Mana Echoes to resolve first, adding {C} for each bear you control.
Before Kindred Discovery resolves, activate Words of Wilding, replacing your next draw with the creation of a 2/2 bear.
Repeat for infinite bears and colorless mana.
